description: This PHP source file defines the ConvertHex class, which is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides static methods for converting hexadecimal values to binary, decimal, and octal representations, including input validation and error handling. The class extends ConvertBase and is part of the Calculation/Engineering namespace, indicating its role in mathematical computations related to engineering calculations within the spreadsheet context.

classes.name: ConvertHex
classes.description: A class providing static methods for converting hexadecimal numbers to binary, decimal, and octal formats, with validation and error handling mechanisms, as part of the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine.

methods.name: toBinary
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal value to binary representation, optionally padded with leading zeros, handling negative numbers, and supporting array inputs.

methods.name: toDecimal
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal value to its decimal equivalent, including two's complement handling for negative numbers and array input support.

methods.name: toOctal
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal value to octal representation, supporting padding with leading zeros, validation, and array inputs.
